wife.","language":"","quote_policy":"summarized"},"literal_observations":[{"id":"obs:1","text":"A person must not ignore a brother’s straying ox, sheep, donkey, garment, or other lost thing, but must keep it if necessary and restore it to the owner.","category":"action","evidence_refs":["ev:1"]},{"id":"obs:2","text":"A person must help lift up a brother’s fallen donkey or ox on the way rather than may be taken.","category":"action","evidence_refs":["ev:4"]},{"id":"obs:5","text":"A new house must have a railing around the roof to prevent bloodguilt if someone falls.","category":"object","evidence_refs":["ev:5"]},{"id":"obs:6","text":"The passage forbids sowing a vineyard with two kinds of seed, plowing with an ox and donkey together, and wearing wool and linen woven together.","category":"action","evidence_refs":["ev:6"]},{"id":"obs:7","text":"The people are commanded to make fringes on the four corners of the cloak used as a covering.","category":"object","evidence_refs":["ev:7"]},{"id":"obs:8","text":"If a husband accuses his wife of lacking tokens of virginity, her parents bring the tokens to the city elders at the gate and spread the cloth before them.","category":"sequence","evidence_refs":["ev:8"]},{"id":"obs:9","text":"If the accusation against the young wife is false, the elders chastise the man, fine him one hundred shekels of silver payable to the father, and require that she remain his wife without divorce.","category":"sequence","evidence_refs":["ev:9"]},{"id":"obs:10","text":"If the accusation is with a married woman, both the man and the woman must die.","category":"action","evidence_refs":["ev:11"]},{"id":"obs:12","text":"If a pledged virgin and a man lie together in the city, both are wife.","category":"sequence","evidence_refs":["ev:12"]},{"id":"obs:13","text":"If a pledged woman is forced in the field, only the man dies; the woman has no death-worthy sin, and the case is compared content.text: {"record_id":"batch.motif.biblical-numbers-web-classic-l69-l161","source_text_path":"texts/public-domain/biblical/world-english-bible-classic/numbers.md","passage_locator":{"label":"Numbers / Chapter 1; lines 69-161","start":"69","end":"161","translation":"numbers","notes":"Stable markdown line range generated from canonical text."},"canonical_text":{"quote":"","summary":"Yahweh speaks to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai and commands a census of the children of Israel by families, fathers' houses, names, and military eligibility.
